events.description: Acquisition of 100% of the voting stock of Ettlinger Group for $53.2 million
events.source_quote: On January 2, 2018, the Company acquired 100 % of the voting stock of Ettlinger Group ("Ettlinger"), within the Fluids segment for $ 53,218 , net of cash acquired.

events.description: Acquisition of 100% of the voting stock of Rosario Handel B.V. for $15.3 million
events.source_quote: On January 12, 2018, the Company acquired 100 % of the voting stock of Rosario Handel B.V. ("Rosario"), within the Refrigeration & Food Equipment segment for total consideration of $ 15,339 , net of cash acquired.

events.description: Subsequent acquisition of Belanger, Inc. for approximately $180 million
events.source_quote: On January 25, 2019, the Company acquired Belanger, Inc. ("Belanger"), a leading full-line car wash equipment manufacturer, for approximately $ 180 million.

events.description: Completed the spin-off of Apergy Corporation through a pro rata distribution of 100% of its common stock
events.source_quote: On May 9, 2018, Dover completed the distribution of Apergy to its shareholders. The transaction was completed through the pro rata distribution of 100% of the common stock of Apergy to Dover's shareholders of record as of the close of business on April 30, 2018.

events.description: Completed the sale of the consumer and industrial winch business of Warn Industries, Inc. for $250.3 million
events.source_quote: On November 1, 2017, the Company completed the sale of the consumer and industrial winch business of Warn Industries, Inc. ("Warn"), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, for total consideration of $ 250,283.

events.description: Completed the sale of Performance Motorsports International (PMI) for total consideration of $147.3 million
events.source_quote: On February 14, 2017, the Company completed the sale of Performance Motorsports International ("PMI"), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company that manufactures pistons and other engine related components serving the motorsports and powersports markets. Total consideration for the transaction was $ 147,313, including cash proceeds of $ 118,706.

events.description: Incurred $58.5 million in restructuring charges from programs initiated in 2017 and 2018
events.source_quote: Total restructuring charges of $ 58,503 incurred during the year ended December 31, 2018, were a result of restructuring programs initiated in 2017 and 2018.

events.description: Voluntary product recall in collaboration with the CPSC due to a product component quality issue in the Fluids segment
events.source_quote: During the fourth quarter of 2016, the Company determined that there was a quality issue with a product component part in the Fluids segment and voluntarily reported this issue to the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (“CPSC”). ... During the first quarter of 2017, the Company announced a voluntary recall of the product in collaboration with the CPSC.

events.description: Richard J. Tobin appointed as President and Chief Executive Officer of Dover
events.source_quote: Richard J. Tobin 55 President and Chief Executive Officer (since May 2018) and Director (since August 2016)

events.description: Repayment of $350 million of matured 5.45% notes on March 15, 2018
events.source_quote: On March 15, 2018, the outstanding 5.45% notes with a principal value of $ 350.0 million matured. The repayment of debt was funded by the Company's commercial paper program and existing cash balances.

events.description: Approved a new standing share repurchase authorization of up to 20 million shares
events.source_quote: In February 2018, the Company's Board of Directors approved a new standing share repurchase authorization, whereby the Company may repurchase up to 20,000,000 shares of its common stock through December 31, 2020.

events.description: Entered into a $700 million accelerated share repurchase agreement with Goldman Sachs
events.source_quote: On May 22, 2018, the Company entered into a $ 700,000 accelerated share repurchase agreement (the “ASR Agreement”) with Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC (“Goldman Sachs”) to repurchase its shares in an accelerated share repurchase program (the “ASR Program”).
